{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the hygiene technology known as a shower|the [[Turboshower/Legends|turboshower]], a similar device}}
[[File:Water_and_sonic_shower.png|thumb|right|200px|A combination water and [[Sonic shower/Legends|sonic shower]] in the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]]]]
A '''shower''' was a place of bathing by application of sprayed [[Water/Legends|water]] upon the naked body, usually found in a [[Refresher/Legends|refresher]]. The shower head was made up of any number of needle jets which dispensed the water. Some public showers charged cleaning fees.

[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] frequently took showers after training [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duels]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. However, [[Gender/Legends|he]] did not always do so, leaving him sweaty on those occasions.<ref name="Shatterpoint">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>
